The '''Elatha system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Stensen sector/Legends|Stensen sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the group known as the [[Elathan]].<ref name="POTJ" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Elatha [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square I-17.<ref name="TEA" />
